RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. A numerical probability would be guesswork. The announcement also doesn’t establish that the successful candidate was less qualified: international leadership experience may have been important to the role.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, the assessment of your application, and applicable review deadlines. Whether two weeks exceeds a legal response deadline depends on the jurisdiction.

Consider raising sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based comments or different treatment linked to sex. Check separately whether local rules require gender-balanced panels; breaching such a rule would not itself prove discriminatory selection.
